Chapter One

Our Love Story

in six small moments

01
📱
followed back!

The First Follow

A double-tap on a sunset photo. Neither of us thought a follow request would become forever.

02

The First Hello

A mutual friend's birthday. Guru's nervous Punjabi greeting made Simran laugh before he'd even finished his sentence.

03
🌙
♥

Late Night Conversations

What started as "goodnight" texts turned into calls that lasted till 3am, about everything and nothing.

04
☕

The First Coffee Date

A tiny Amritsar café, two cups gone cold, and a conversation neither of them wanted to end.

05

Falling In Love

Somewhere between road trips, family dinners, and inside jokes — they stopped noticing the falling, and just landed.

06
💍

The Proposal

Under a sky full of stars, Guru asked the only question left to ask. Simran said yes before he finished it.

A Taste of Punjab

Lunch & Dinner

hover a card to see its story

01

Butter Chicken

"

Simmered all night in a velvet tomato gravy — Guru's favourite since childhood.

02

Dal Makhani

"

Slow-cooked black lentils, finished with cream — the soul of every Punjabi table.

03

Paneer Lababdar

"

Soft paneer in a rich onion-tomato curry, spiced just the way Simran's nani makes it.

04

Amritsari Kulcha

"

Stuffed, golden, and straight from the tandoor — best torn by hand.

05

Tandoori Roti

"

Smoky, char-kissed bread, served hot off the clay oven all night long.

06

Jalebi

"

Crisp, syrup-soaked spirals — because every Punjabi wedding needs something sweet and golden.

07

Rabri

"

Thickened sweet milk, slow-reduced for hours, topped with pistachio slivers.

08

Lassi

"

Cool, frothy, and unapologetically generous — the way every Punjabi summer should taste.
